video_title: The Brunson REINVENTION, KAT's Evolution, and What Happens with MSG Ticket Prices?!

quotes.speaker: Paul Pierce
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul Pierce on the hangover effect of beating defending champions
quotes.excerpt: When you beat the defending champs, it almost feels like you won a championship, but you actually didn't.
quotes.quote: When you beat the defending champs, it almost feels like you won a championship, but you actually didn't. You can just see the hangover from that because this is not the same team that was locked in.

quotes.speaker: Paul Pierce
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul Pierce and Danny Green on Jalen Brunson's potential statue in New York
quotes.excerpt: He wins a title in New York, he's definitely getting a statue, bro.

text_blocks.speaker: Paul Pierce
text_blocks.text: I won a title in Boston, I'm probably not going to get a statue. He wins a title in New York, he's definitely getting a statue, bro.

text_blocks.speaker: Danny Green
text_blocks.text: They're bringing the people together, bro. It's just unity. It's wild.

quotes.speaker: Paul Pierce
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul Pierce on the difficulty of winning a title with a Kyrie-led team
quotes.excerpt: I've never seen a Kyrie-led team win a title.
quotes.quote: I have to agree with that because I've never seen a Kyrie-led team win a title.

quotes.speaker: Danny Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Danny Green on the Knicks' historic post-season winning streak
quotes.excerpt: The Knicks have now the second-longest winning streak of all time in the post-season.
quotes.quote: The Knicks have now the second-longest winning streak of all time in the post-season. They have won 13 in a row, second to only the Warriors who have won 15 in 2017.

quotes.speaker: Paul Pierce
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul Pierce on the Spurs' youth showing in the playoffs
quotes.excerpt: For the first time in all the playoffs, I feel like their youth is starting to show.
quotes.quote: For the first time in all the playoffs, I feel like their youth is starting to show. Costly turnovers, bad possessions, not being on the same page, a lot of little things that you didn't see throughout the playoffs from the Spurs.

quotes.speaker: Paul Pierce
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul Pierce on the lack of intimidation at Madison Square Garden
quotes.excerpt: It's not an arena to where you like, damn, we got to go here and play.
quotes.quote: It's not an arena to where you like, damn, we got to go here and play. A lot of guys going into the Garden have career highs. I had a career high. I see Kobe put a career high. I just seen Steph Curry put up career highs in the Madison Square Garden. They're comfortable there.

quotes.speaker: Paul Pierce
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul Pierce on Karl-Anthony Towns' transformation as a playmaker
quotes.excerpt: I wasn't a big fan of KAT in Minnesota, but I love what he's morphed into.
quotes.quote: I wasn't a big fan of KAT in Minnesota, but I love what he's morphed into since the playoffs started in Atlanta. He was always a good talent to me, but I thought there was something missing from his game to where you could win it all with a player like him. When he started becoming this guy who became a better passer, I was like, hold on. This is an element I haven't seen from KAT.

quotes.speaker: Paul Pierce
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul Pierce on Karl-Anthony Towns as a Finals MVP candidate
quotes.excerpt: He is probably the favorite to win Finals MVP because he's shooting a high percentage.
quotes.quote: He is probably the favorite to win Finals MVP because he's shooting a high percentage, he's rebounding at a high level, he's passing, and doing all the necessary things that you need from a big guy to help win on both ends of the court.

quotes.speaker: Paul Pierce
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul Pierce on why the Knicks aren't an all-time great team
quotes.excerpt: You beat Cleveland and you beat Philly. Nobody had those two teams in any trajectory.
quotes.quote: You beat Cleveland and you beat Philly. Nobody had those two teams in any trajectory of going anywhere anyway. Now, if you sweep the Spurs, a young team, what does that say? Oh, they're a young team led by a 22-year-old, a 21-year-old, and a 20-year-old. I still don't put them up there with the all-time great teams.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green on the Knicks' path to the Conference Finals
quotes.excerpt: You can get to the conference finals with playing very mid teams.

text_blocks.speaker: Draymond Green
text_blocks.text: In the Eastern Conference, you can get to the conference finals with playing very mid teams. And so that's kind of what y'all are doing right now. And I think what this is setting up for y'all is for what happened to the Atlanta Hawks three years ago when they made the conference finals and they never got back.

text_blocks.speaker: Paul Pierce
text_blocks.text: I'm a Knicks hater and I'm not ashamed to admit it. I hate the Knicks.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green on the Trail Blazers' failed 2019 conference finals run
quotes.excerpt: We swept them pretty much without Steph Curry.
quotes.quote: Another team that did this to give you some perspective was the Portland Trail Blazers years ago when they had Al-Farouq Aminu, Allen Crabbe, all those guys. They went to the conference finals and we swept them pretty much without Steph Curry. They ran off and paid all of those guys because they thought they had a team that had a chance and it was a fluke.

quotes.speaker: Paul Pierce
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul Pierce on the Knicks' window of opportunity
quotes.excerpt: I truly believe that this is the window opportunity for the Knicks.
quotes.quote: I truly believe that this is the window opportunity for the Knicks. Next year Boston is going to be back better. You got Atlanta, they're going to be better. You got Indiana, they're going to come back healthy and strong with their draft pick and having Haliburton back. So I truly believe this is their window.

quotes.speaker: Paul Pierce
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul Pierce on why the Knicks aren't a top-three team
quotes.excerpt: Unless they got three players on this team that become Hall of Famers, I'm not putting them in that category.
quotes.quote: Unless they got three players on this team that become Hall of Famers, I'm not putting them in that category. I know they won and they're on a historical run, but I'm not putting them in no top-10 all-time great teams.

quotes.speaker: Paul Pierce
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul Pierce on Jalen Brunson's Hall of Fame trajectory
quotes.excerpt: Jalen Brunson is actually on the verge of winning a title before Luka Doncic.
quotes.quote: Jalen Brunson is actually on the verge of winning a title before Luka Doncic, a guy he played with. There's going to be some tough conversations made if the Knicks win this title about Jalen Brunson and where he stands in NBA history as one of the better guards. The things that make him special is his IQ, his ability to be clutch, his ability to understand the moment.

quotes.speaker: Paul Pierce
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul Pierce on the difficulty of winning a title as a small guard
quotes.excerpt: It's tough to win a championship if your best player is a small guard.
quotes.quote: It's tough to win a championship if your best player is a small guard. The only guards that we've seen in NBA history be your best player is guys like Stephen Curry, Isaiah Thomas. It's tough to win a championship. Usually you need a guy who runs a 6-6, 6-7 mark at least to be your best player to win it.

quotes.speaker: Paul Pierce
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul Pierce on Karl-Anthony Towns as the Knicks' most consistent player
quotes.excerpt: KAT has actually been their best player in the finals.
quotes.quote: KAT has actually been their best player in the finals. Because I was like, if the Knicks are going to win, they need to get a player that's better than Brunson, or KAT has to play better than him, which he has done.

quotes.speaker: Paul Pierce
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul Pierce on Jalen Brunson's clutch performance
quotes.excerpt: Jalen Brunson is actually on the verge of winning a title before Luka Doncic.
quotes.quote: Jalen Brunson is actually on the verge of winning a title before Luka Doncic, a guy he played with. There's going to be some tough conversations made if the Knicks win this title about Jalen Brunson and where he stands in NBA history as one of the better guards. And as great as Kyrie has been in his career, there's going to be some tough conversations made if or when the Knicks win this title about Jalen Brunson and where he stands in NBA history as one of the better guards.

quotes.speaker: Paul Pierce
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul Pierce on Jalen Brunson's clutch status
quotes.excerpt: Jalen Brunson is a guy that we all considered a guy who even a year ago was voted by his peers as the most clutch player.
quotes.quote: Jalen Brunson is a guy that we all considered a guy who even a year ago was voted by his peers as the most clutch player in the NBA and he's still showing those things.
